en.bestFor: Showing one character put on an outfit piece by piece, in the order you list, then hold the finished look.
en.structure: One 3–4 second clip per garment, plus one final clip where the full look holds. Four garments make five clips.
en.hook: Opens already wearing the starting outfit you name, as the first listed garment goes on. No title card.
en.arc: Starting outfit, then each listed piece lands and stays. The next clip begins on the previous clip's finished outfit. The last clip holds the complete look.
en.narrator: Silent by default. A short spoken line that names the finished look is added only when you ask for one, and only on the last clip.
en.visual: Look and palette come from the chosen visual style. One room and one locked full-body camera, with the character at a similar size. Face and hair stay on the blueprint. Clothes follow your list and accumulate.
en.audio: A music bed with one clothing sound effect per clip. Silent clips have no subtitle.
en.rules: Needs exactly one character, the garment order, and a starting outfit. Only those garments, in that order, one action per clip. No half-second flash cuts and no invented pieces.
